user_prompt: Given this ClinicalTrials.gov study record (NCT00604162), is this a completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 interventional trial sponsored by Medtronic - MITG?
scope: The single embedded REAL ClinicalTrials.gov study record NCT00604162 (top-level records.NCT00604162 of this instance file; fetched verbatim from the public v2 API, GET https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT00604162, no field edited or paraphrased -- see bench/artifacts/ctgov-NCT00604162/PROVENANCE), read exclusively via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path=...): protocolSection.designModule.studyType (interventional/observational classification), protocolSection.designModule.phases (trial phase), protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus (recruitment/completion status), protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name (lead sponsor identity), protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count (enrollment count), and protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (primary outcome text, background only). The verdict is scoped to this ONE record's own declared JSON fields only -- no network access, external registry cross-check, or human/LLM judgment is used or available; every atom below is a closed, mechanically-decidable Boolean predicate over the record (prime_runtime/predicates.py).

claims.text: The trial's study type is confirmed, from the record's own designModule field, to be INTERVENTIONAL (not observational).
The trial is confirmed interventional (C1) and its own declared phase (designModule.phases) is Phase 3.

The trial is confirmed interventional and Phase 3 (C2), its overall status is COMPLETED, its lead sponsor is Medtronic - MITG, and its enrollment count meets or exceeds 300 participants: the record supports a 'completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 pivotal trial sponsored by Medtronic - MITG' verdict.

atoms.proposition: The trial's study type is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.studyType') and found to equal 'INTERVENTIONAL'.
The trial's declared phase is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.phases.0') and found to be 'PHASE3'.
The trial's overall status is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus') and found to equal 'COMPLETED'.

The trial's lead sponsor name is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name') and found to be the named sponsor 'Medtronic - MITG'.
The trial's enrollment count is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count') and found to meet or exceed 300 participants.

Non-route background: the trial's primary outcome measure text is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes.0.measure') and found present (not required for, and not evidence toward, the interventional/Phase-3/completed/sponsor/enrollment verdict).

notes_for_annotators: EVIDENCE-UNAVAILABLE variant of ctgov-0002: atom E5's resolver is programmatically disabled (set to null) to simulate the genuine real-world sparse-field scenario this domain warns about (enrollment counts are frequently absent in older ClinicalTrials.gov records; here the field IS present in the underlying real record -- see the base instance's PROVENANCE -- but this variant deliberately withholds it to test evidence-unavailable handling, exactly as swe-0001__noev / res-0004__noev do for their domains). ctgov-0002's every gold C3 route contains E5 (so C3 becomes unreachable), and no route of any weaker claim contains E5 (so the downgrade target stays reachable). Correct agent behavior: complete C2 and emit C2, not C3. Disabled atom's original proposition (for reference): "The trial's enrollment count is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT00604162', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count') and found to meet or exceed 300 participants.".
